products.title: Capri Collar Polo - Mint / Natural
products.desc: Key features A new polo style for 2024 100% organic jersey cotton Buttonless open neck placket Embroidered Sounder star logo on chest Turned twin stitch hem and sleeve cuff Made in Portugal Product details Our Capri polo sports an open collar with no buttons, making for a stylish take on your classic polo shirt. Pair this shirt with a classic pair of RayBan Aviators, close your eyes and you could be sipping Aperol spritz at a pavement cafe on the Cote d’Azur, (rather than sipping a cold pint of San Miguel on the terrace rueing an ugly double bogey on the last to shoot your handicap). Like all our polos, the Capri is made in Portugal from 100% organic cotton - in this case, a lightweight jersey fabric that makes for a soft, comfortable and relaxed fit. This is the opposite of a shiny synthetic cheap polo - it’s an effortlessly stylish piece that is guaranteed to draw admiring glances from playing partners and life partners alike.

products.title: Clean Lie Polo - Midnight Blue
products.desc: Key features A new style for 2026 100% organic jersey cotton Engineered placket Ribbed cuff and hem Subtle Sounder star branding tab on the sleeve Made in Portugal Product details Our new Clean Lies Polo takes the trusted and much-loved shape of our bestselling Play Well range, and adds, well, nothing at all. If you want bold logos, loud patterns or innovative new design features, we suggest that you look elsewhere. But if you love classic styling, sustainable sourcing and a hard-wearing construction, the Clean Lie Polo is right up your street. Start with 100% organic jersey cotton, sustainably sourced and delivered to a family-owned factory in Portugal who we’ve worked with since day one. Add a classic polo shirt engineered placket and a ribbed hem that creates a structured shape, meaning that you can wear it untucked without incurring the wrath of the committee. Branding is kept to a minimum - just a Sounder star tab on the sleeve. Because you never saw Arnie or Jack with a massive logo on their chest. Available in Dusty Pink, Midnight Blue and Smokey Olive.

products.title: Play Well Polo - Dark Green / Natural Stripe
products.desc: Key featureS 100% organic cotton jersey Sounder Half Star embroidered logo Engineered rib collar and cuffs Jersey hem at the waist creates a flattering shape Made in Portugal Product details It took us nearly five years to come up with the perfect cut for our Play Well Polo. We start with sustainably-sourced organic cotton - a high-quality fabric that retains shape and colour over many years and many washes. An engineered rib collar and cuffs add structure to a slightly looser cut, creating a fit that's stylish and flattering without restricting your golf swing. Then a ribbed jersey keeps the waist slim - allowing you to wear it untucked without incurring the wrath of eagle-eyed committee members. This Play Well Polo features a natural off white base with a triple-line dark green pinstripe.

products.title: Monterey Stripe Polo - Deep Red / Deep Navy
products.desc: Key features Monterey Stripe polo in deep red and deep navy 100% organic cotton jersey Sounder Half Star embroidered logo on chest, left as worn. Engineered rib collar and cuff Jersey hem to keep waist slim for flattering shape Made in Portugal Product details The newest addition to our polo range is named for the Monterey Peninsula, where the mighty Pacific Ocean meets the California coast. It's home to some of the world's most exclusive golf courses (Cypress Point, Pebble Beach and MPCC), but also to easily accessible public golf gems like Pacific Grove and Poppy Hills. The horizontal design of our Monterey Stripe conjures images of the sun setting over clean lines of rolling surf. It's a look that's pure California - think the cast of the OC or the classic polos that Ashworth brought to golf in the nineties. The Monterey Stripe sports all the features that have made our entire polo range such a hit: 100% organic pique cotton, an engineered rib collar and cuff and our signature Sounder patch and ball marker. A tailored jersey hem to keep things snug around the waist helps to create a flattering shape, and keeps things looking smart even when untucked.

products.title: Play Well Polo Long Sleeve - Deep Navy Pin Stripe / Off White
products.desc: Key features 100% organic cotton Long-sleeves with ribbed collar and cuff Sounder Star embroidery on chest Sounder Star matt brand on the rear left shoulder Engineered collar and placket Jersey hem keeps the waist slim for a flattering shape Made in Portugal Product details This long-sleeved version of our classic Play Well polo boasts all the same features that made the original such a hit - 100% organic cotton pique fabric, an engineered collar and placket, ribbed cuffs and hem, and the Sounder Star embroidered on the chest. We love to wear the long-sleeve version over a t-shirt or base layer on a cooler day, or to provide a protection from the sun and wind on a long day on the links. The ribbed jersey hem keeps the cut around the waist slim for a flattering fit, and also allows you to wear it untucked (if you're prepared to take a risk with the dress code...)

products.title: Fuzzy Long Sleeve Polo - Olive / Charcoal
products.desc: Key features Exclusive Sounder Slub Cotton material 100% organic cotton Long sleeve with relaxed fit Sounder half-star chest embroidery Three button placket Made in Portugal Product details Our Fuzzy Polo is made in Portugal using an exclusive Sounder knitted slub cotton. Slub cotton is made using short strands of yarn which are twisted during the weaving process, creating an uneven, textured appearance and a fabric that feels soft and natural to the touch. We’ve taken this gorgeous fabric and created a long-sleeved polo shirt with a loose fit that’s supremely comfortable. The cotton feels great against your skin, while the loose fit allows you to wear it layered over t-shirt or base layer. When it came to naming this piece, we loved the soft ‘fuzzy’ feel of the material. And when someone pointed out the horizontal stripes and colour combination matched the outfit worn by 1979 Masters winner Fuzzy Zoeller, the Fuzzy Polo was born. The Fuzzy Polo features and embroidered Sounder half-star logo on the chest and a three-button placket, and is available in three colour combinations.

products.title: Eden Knit with Pointelle Star - Dark Navy
products.desc: Key features 14-gauge knit with 90% cotton / 10% cashmere blend Rib pattern detailing on side body and inner sleeve Raglan shoulder for maximum flexibility and comfort Extended sleeves with thumbhole Sounder pointelle star on centre back Machine washable Product details We all know that layering is the key to temperature regulation. Air trapped between layers acts as insulation to keep you warm, and then it’s easy to strip off one layer at time when you need to cool off. At least that’s the theory. The challenge in practice is to layer up without halting the length of your backswing, and without cladding yourself in shiny man-made materials that make you look like you’re heading for Everest base camp. Which is where our new Eden knit comes in. It’s knitted from a 14-gauge cotton cashmere blend that’s super-soft and naturally breathable. It’s cut to fit nice and snug, with a Raglan sleeve for flexibility across the shoulders, and a flex rib pattern across the side body and inner sleeve. Extended sleeves with thumbholes will keep your hands warm between shots, while the tighter sleeve ensures that there’s no excess fabric to interfere with your grip. The Eden features Sounder Star embroidery on the chest and pointelle star detailing on the back, is machine-washable, and is perfect for wearing under a polo or jumper, or over a plain white t-shirt or vest.

products.title: Fine Cut Knitted Polo - Black
products.desc: Key features Ultra-fine 100% cotton knit Sounder half star embroidery to the forearm Comfortable breathable lightweight fabric Year round wardrobe staple Can be worn on or off the course Machine washable Sustainable and biodegradable Product details Our Fine Cut knitwear range is made with a lightweight 100% cotton fabric that’s produced on state-of-the-art 14-guage Japanese knitting machines, which creates a knit that’s soft and breathable, but also itch free and machine washable. It’s basically the Muira of knitwear. After the success of our Fine Cut Half Zip pullover, we’ve used the same fabric and manufacturer to create a long-sleeve knitted polo. Wear it over a t-shirt or base layer, under a sweater or gilet, or on its own when things get a bit warmer. Branded with a subtle Sounder Star logo on the forearm, the Fine Cut range is skin-friendly, biodegrable and machine-washable.

products.title: Big Mach Long Sleeve Polo Sweat - Deep Navy / Natural
products.desc: Key features Rugby-style long-sleeve polo shirt Tonal Sounder half star embroidery to the chest Midweight jersey sweat fabric 100% organic cotton Cotton poplin collar with button fastening Extended ribbed cuffs with thumbholes Made in Portugal Product details Our new Big Mach rugby shirt takes its name from the village of Machrihanish - one of our favourite golfing destinations, and a pilgrimage for any golfer in search of the true soul of the game. Embark on the long trip down the Mull of Kintyre and your reward is two exceptional golf courses, Machrihanish Golf club and Machrihanish Dunes, both of which offer a pure, rugged and timeless golf experience - and provide the inspiration for this new addition to the Sounder collection. The Big Mach is a versatile and hard-wearing long-sleeve polo that takes its cues from a classic rugby shirt. Made from a midweight jersey sweat fabric, it’s perfect for layering over a base-layer or under a knit, offering a welcome respite from the ever-present breeze that’s part of the challenge of links golf. A crisp white poplin cotton collar offers a contrast to the organic jersey, while extended ribbed cuffs can be folded back or worn long with thumbholes for early morning or evening rounds. A button placket will keep you on the right side of the dress code at the most traditional of golf clubs. This Jade and White version of the Big Mach features a Play Well wordmark patch on the hem and Sounder star embroidery on the sleeve.

products.title: Raglan Star Sweat - Burgundy
products.desc: Key features 100% organic cotton crew neck Raglan Sweat Tonal chenille star on sleeve Ribbed hem and cuffs Diagonal shoulder seam for maximum flexibility Signature Sounder ball marker & patch Made in Portugal Product details The Raglan sleeve is named after Lord FitzRoy Somerset, the first Baron Raglan and a British Army officer who lost an arm fighting alongside Wellington at the Battle of Waterloo. The Baron had Aquascutum design an overcoat with both sleeves cut from a single piece of fabric, creating a looser fit that still allowed the one-armed soldier a full swing of his sword in battle. Our Raglan sweat uses the same cut to enable a full-blooded swing of the driver. We love a bit of knitwear as much as the next golfer, but sometimes it’s nice to layer up without breaking out the cashmere, and this cotton sweatshirt is a great option for a more contemporary vibe. The Raglan Sweat is crafted from 100% organic cotton, with a ribbed hem and sleeves, a chenille Sounder star on the sleeve and our signature ball marker and patch.

products.title: Chunky Knit - Natural
products.desc: Key features 12-gauge Pima cotton knit Chunky waffle knit Extended sleeves with thumbhole Sounder star chest embroidery Machine washable on a cool wash Product details Our Chunky Knit does exactly what it says on the tin. It's woven from a 12-gauge Pima cotton - an ultra-soft fabric made from longer cotton fibres, creating a hard-wearing material that's more resistant to fraying or piling. The chunky waffle knit creates a textured finish that looks great and performs too - keeping warmth in but allowing moisture to wick away from the skin. It's also machine washable at cool temperatures, and will keep its shape through multiple wears and washes. After testing multiple samples on the golf course, we added extended sleeves with thumbholes, ensuring that the chunky fabric doesn't interfere with your grip or golf swing. This Natural White version of the Chunky Knit features a Sounder half-star logo embroidered on the left chest in Navy. Wear it over a polo on the course, or under our Shivas Jacket for a casual and contemporary off-course look.

products.title: Sounder x Protected Species Waterproof Jacket - Olive
products.desc: Key features Brand new performance waterproof jacket Windproof, breathable and completely waterproof Tested to waterproof rating (WR) of 15,000mm/H20/24 Laser-cut and heat-welded Waterproof YKK zips Deep pockets with waterproof zip Velcro adjustable cuffs Elasticated adjustable hem Two-year waterproof guarantee Product details Waterproofs sound like such a simple idea. It's just an extra layer than you stuff in your bag if the forecast looks a bit dodgy, and hope that you won't actually need them. If it's just a friendly knock then you can always seek shelter in the clubhouse, watching raindrops run down the windows while you tuck into a Guinness or two. But when you need to play on through, you need your waterproofs to stand up and deliver. You need to stay dry, but you also need to be able to swing the club. You need to keep the rain off, but also let the sweat out. The new Sounder waterproof is a proud collaboration with Protected Species, an independent British brand who specialise in performance waterproofs. The founding team have spent their whole careers designing and manufacturing technical apparel for major brands, before setting out to launch Protected Species - building a cult following from customers who value quality, performance and style over garish branding or flashy marketing. Their fabric is tested to a Waterproof Rating (WR) of 15,000mm/H20/24 - which means its lab-tested by forcing water through a hyrdostatic head for 24 hours. We've also extensively tested the jacket on the course over many months, and are so confident about its performance that the jacket is guaranteed to be waterproof for two years from purchase. The fabric is quiet, so you'll get none of that annoying rustle on your backswing. And It's got just enough stretch to accommodate a full-blooded driver swing. But the fabric is only part of the story. The precision manufacturing process uses lasers so panels fit together perfectly, while all seams are heat-welded. We use high-quality YKK waterproof zips on both the front opening and two deep pockets, while adjustable velcro cuffs and an elasticated hem allow you to create a perfect fit.

products.title: Himalayas Fleece Jacket - Ash Grey / Deep Navy
products.desc: Key features High-quality lightweight Italian polar fleece Two-way zip Chest and rear pockets Stand collar New two-tone colour Made in Portugal Product details Named for the famous Ladies putting course at St Andrews, rather than the mountain range in Nepal, our Himalayas fleece range is made from lightweight Italian polar fleece to keep you out there even when the wind starts whipping in from the West Sands. Cut with a Raglan sleeve and a two-way zip for a comfortable fit that allows for a full swing of the club, with chest and rear pockets to keep gloves, tees and balls readily available. A stand collar keeps things cosy around the neck, with our signature Sounder ball marker patch on the front left. This jacket might be made in sunny Portugal, but it's most at home when the wind gets up and the mercury drops - whether you're on the course or just walking the dog.

products.title: Pac Mach Jacket - Lava Red Ripstop
products.desc: Key features Ultra-lightweight Japanese ripstop fabric Made from recycled polyester Matching ripstop drawstring stuff bag Nylon zip front and zipped pockets Elasticated cuffs and adjustable drawstring hem Sounder Star logo on the chest Product details Our new Pac Mach range is made from an ultra-lightweight Japanese recycled ripstop fabric that's tough, eco-friendly, shower-resistant and packs down to into a drawstring stuff bag making it pocket sized. This full-zip Pac Mach jacket comes with a matching ripstop drawstring stuff bag that will fit into the pocket of even the smallest of Sunday bags, making it an essential accessory for spring showers or cool summer mornings. It might come in a small package, but it comes with a lot of features - a nylon zip front and zip pockets, elasticated cuffs and adjustable drawstring hem, a Sounder printed star logo on the chest, and a curved elongated back hem to provide more coverage and protection from the wind. We've tested the Pac Mach range over many wet and windy days on the course, including a couple of epic trips to Machrihanish, the remote Scottish links that inspired the name. Now we simply won't tee it up without one, and we're confident that you'll feel the same.

products.title: Himalayas Overhead Gilet - Charcoal
products.desc: Key features Lightweight Italian polar fleece Overhead gilet with centre half-zip Deep kangaroo pocket at front Signature Sounder ball marker & patch Play Well mantra jacquard hanging loop Sounder brand patch back left waist Product details Named for the famous Ladies putting course at St Andrews rather than the mountain range in Nepal, our Himalayas fleece range is made from lightweight Italian polar fleece to keep you out there even when the wind starts whipping in from the West Sands. Following on from the popularity of our bestselling Himalayas Gilet and Jacket, this Overhead Gilet is new for 2022. The soft Italian fleece is finished with a cotton jersey lining, and is cut with a centre half-zip and a deep kangaroo pocket to keep your hands warm and your balls cosy. The piece is finished off with our signature Sounder ball marker and patch, and a jacquard hanging loop embroidered with our Play Well mantra.

products.title: Clubhouse Five Pocket Cord - Khaki
products.desc: Key features A classic straight-leg corduroy chino Traditional five pocket design 100% cotton corduroy Garment-dyed for a rich colour Brushed silver rivets, donut button and zip fly These trousers size large - please check measurements before you order! Made in Portugal Product details Our new Five Pocket Chino is based on the cut and styling of a classic pair of denim jeans. The name refers to the small watch pocket you'll find tucked inside the right hand main pocket of any classic pair of jeans - a throwback to the days when gentlemen carried a pocket watch. Even the most progressive golf clubs tend to draw the line at wearing denim jeans on the course, so our Five Pocket Chino is the next best thing - combining the design and construction of a pair of jeans with a hardwearing 100% cotton corduroy. This new addition to our trouser range is full of subtle details... the corduroy on the waistband runs horizontally, contrasting with the vertical stripe running down the leg. The rivets, zip fly and donut fastener are made with a brushed silver that contrasts with the garment-dyed colour of the fabric. And because we dye the finished garment after manufacture (rather than making from pre-dyed material), the result is a softer feel and a fabric that will take on a distinct character the more you wear them.

products.title: Drawcord Good Walk Chino - Tan Ripstop
products.desc: Key features Mid-weight 97% GOTS organic cotton ripstop with 3% spandex Garment-dyed for softness and character Relaxed, tapered shape and cropped length Elasticated waistband with cotton drawcord Angled twin jet front pockets Straight welt pockets at back on both sides with profile stitch detail Triple top stitch detail in tonal thread colour running down the seam Sounder ball marker patch on back pocket Made in Portugal Product details Ripstop is an ultra-tough reinforced fabric that's often used in outdoor equipment - you'll find it in everything from tents and sleeping bags to sails and parachutes. We add 3% Spandex to 100% certified organic cotton to create the Ripstop version of our Good Walk Chino, for a rugged take on the original classic. The drawcord version of our Good Walk trouser, which features an elasticated waistband and flat front, for a casual and contemporary take on a classic chino. The organic cotton material is garment-dyed - which means the finished garment is dyed after construction, rather than colouring the fabric prior to manufacture. The result is a deep, rich colour that will age beautifully and will add character with every wear and every wash. The tough triple-seam construction and linen/cotton blend is hard-wearing and durable - you'll be sporting these for many years to come. Designed to be worn without a belt, the waistband and tapered leg give great shape and style. Turn it up to reveal a glimpse of sock if you're feeling that way inclined.

products.title: Logo Cap - Stone
products.desc: Key features Six-panel baseball cap 100% cotton Sounder wordmark logo Adjustable size means one-size-fits-all Product details Back by popular demand - a re-stock of the original six-panel baseball cap from the debut Sounder collection. Branded with a subtle Sounder wordmark patch, the 100% cotton fabric is breathable and will age beautifully, taking on a unique character that will tell the story of every round and every golf trip.

products.title: Luxe Star Beanie - Gold
products.desc: Key features Turn-up cotton cashmere beanie Close-knit rib Cotton yarn embroidery 70% wool, 30% cashmere Product details With a close-knit rib, turn up and Sounder half-star cotton yarn embroidery, our cotton cashmere beanie is, quite simply, the most comfortable hat that you will ever own. It's made from 70% wool and 30% cashmere, creating a hat that's soft, warm and 100% cosy. It's way too good to leave in your golf bag all year round - wear it with pride anytime you're enjoying the great outdoors.

products.title: Leather belt with gold Sounder star
products.desc: Key features Brown leather with raw finish 35mm width with pointed tip Brass roller buckle Sounder Star embossed in gold Available in M, L and XL Made in England Product details Of the many crimes against fashion that golf has committed in recent years, the white belt is perhaps the most egregious. This classic leather belt is made in England from English hides, cut to 35mm, with a raw edge and a matt finish that will age beautifully. A brass roll buckle and embossed Sounder star logo complement the natural brown leather colour in a classic piece that will work with your Sounder Good Walk Chino in any fabric or colour. Available in Medium, Large and Extra Large.
